items: A sore spot over the bump

caption:
Koko's new shoes are making the bump by her big toe ache.

A bunion is a change in the angle of the big toe joint, and genetics and foot shape play a big part. Exercises and shoes usually won't straighten the toe, but they can ease pain, reduce pressure on the bump and keep you walking comfortably.

Start with a wide, deep toe box and a few minutes of toe spreading and big-toe lifts most days.

A red, hot or quickly swelling joint, numb toes or a sore over the bump are worth checking promptly, especially if you have diabetes. Our Chatswood and Sydney CBD physios can help. Book online via the link in bio.

General information only — not a substitute for an individual assessment.
